chunks: ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Dāwūd al-Nahdī, from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
He said to me: “We are equal in knowledge and bravery, and in grants, according to the measure of what we are commanded.”

key_terms.الْعِلْمِ: knowledge possessed by the Imams عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: Are the Imams عليهم السلام equal in knowledge and bravery?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Imams عليهم السلام are equal in knowledge and bravery. It also indicates that their giving or granting is exercised according to the command they receive.
